releaseNotes:
PRVN Music v0.16 (Build 20):
- Complete native Android launcher icon switching with proper Activity-Alias lifecycle.
- Full preservation of 18 official PRVN Music reference logos from Concept Sheets 1 & 2.
- V1 — Minimal Neon set as the official default application icon.
- Android adaptive icon safe zone compliance (no symbol or lettering cropping under circle, squircle, or pebble masks).
- Density mipmap generation for mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi, and mipmap-anydpi-v26.
- Elimination of inherited YMusic icons and assets from project.
- Official PRVN Music GitHub branding, documentation, and preview alignment.
- Reliable icon persistence across device reboots, app updates, and background restoration.
